loginHint: 🎰 Every prompt is a spin. Run /vibe-login to take a seat at the table.
noRound: The wheel stopped without you. Next prompt, next spin.
spinSaved: 🎰 Spin saved for later · {count} pending. Open /roulette and hit SPIN.
spinSaved.one: 🎰 Spin saved for later · {count} pending. Open /roulette and hit SPIN.
spinDropped: 🎰 {count} pending spins is the limit: this prompt was not saved
spinDropped.one: 🎰 {count} pending spin is the limit: this prompt was not saved
pendingHint: 🎰 {count} pending spins (prompts with the window closed). Spend them with SPIN in /roulette.
pendingHint.one: 🎰 {count} pending spin (a prompt with the window closed). Spend it with SPIN in /roulette.
command.bet.description: Bet fake coins on the current or next spin
command.allIn.description: Bet your whole balance (red by default)
command.balance.description: Balance, debt, net worth and rank
command.show.description: Show up on the public leaderboard again
command.server.description: Show or change the vibe-gambling server
command.deleteAccount.description: Delete your account and all its data
notLoggedIn: You're not logged in. Run /vibe-login first.
offline: 🎰 The casino is unreachable right now. Your fake coins are safe (they were never real).
badConfig: vibe-gambling is misconfigured: {errors}. Fix it in /config.
windowFailed: Couldn't open the window. Is there a browser around?
betBadAmount: "{raw}" is not an amount. Whole fake coins only (or "all-in").
betBadTarget: "{raw}" is too long to be a square on this table.
insufficientFunds: Not enough fake coins. The Ludo-Credit Express is in the window, if you're brave.
tooManyBets: Too many chips on the table for one spin. Even addicts have limits.
invalidBet: "{target}" is not a square on this table.
rankNewAccount: on the leaderboard from {date} (new GitHub account)
alreadyLoggedIn: You're already logged in as @{login}. /vibe-logout first to switch.
loginPrompt: 🎰 Go to {uri} and enter {code}. You have {minutes} min; I'll keep checking in the background.
loginInProgress: Still waiting: go to {uri} and enter {code}.
loginPublicNotice: Heads-up: you appear on the public leaderboard (login and avatar). /vibe-hide to vanish.
loginNewAccount: Your GitHub account is under {days} days old: you play as usual and show up on the public leaderboard (login and avatar) from {date}. /vibe-hide to stay off it.
loginExpired: The login code expired. Run /vibe-login to get a new one.
loginDenied: GitHub login was cancelled. The table will wait.
loginFailed: The login stopped: the server said "{detail}". Run /vibe-login to try again.
loggedOut: 🎰 Logged out. The wheel will miss you.
notLoggedInLogout: You weren't logged in. Mission accomplished anyway.
hidden: 🎰 You're hidden from the leaderboard (and the Hall of Ruin).
shown: 🎰 You're back on the leaderboard. Shame is public again.
serverNeedsHttps: "{raw}" uses plain http: your session token would travel in clear text. Use https (http is only for localhost).
serverIncompatible: {url} speaks protocol v{protocol}, this mod speaks v{expected}. Server not changed.
serverChanged: 🎰 Now playing at {url} — {name}{state}. Log in there with /vibe-login.
deleteUsage: This deletes your account and every spin, forever. To confirm, type: /vibe-delete-account {login}
deleteMismatch: That's not your login. Nothing was deleted.
deleted: 🎰 Account deleted. All data is gone. The house thanks you for playing.
dailyLimit: 🎰 Daily spin limit reached · the table reopens at {time}
